top_signals.title: Need Accountability, Transparency in FAA Funding, Says Sen. Capito
top_signals.summary: Republican Senator Shelley Moore Capito of West Virginia talks about government funding, energy permitting reform and concerns about advanced chips going to China. Capito said that there needs to be more a 'accountability' and 'transparency' for FAA funding, adding that Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy's request for $50 Billion in additional funding didn't rise to that level. Capito stressed that the transportation system does need to be funded and should be backed on a bipartisan basis.  (Source: Bloomberg)
